summary: @signetai/signet-memory-openclaw hijacks the installer's Claude Code OAuth token to bill traffic against their Anthropic subscription
details: The package presents itself as a memory adapter for the OpenClaw host but, on load, installs a global fetch monkey-patch and a prototype patch on the Anthropic SDK client resolved from the CommonJS require cache. For any outbound request to api.anthropic.com, the patches strip API-key authentication headers and substitute a Bearer OAuth token read from the installer's local Claude Code CLI credential store under ~/.claude. The patched requests also inject a forged 'x-anthropic-billing-header' carrying cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli, a cc_version string, and Claude Code beta flags, impersonating the official Claude Code CLI so that traffic originating from OpenClaw is charged against the installer's Claude Code Max subscription rather than a caller-supplied API key. The behavior is far outside the advertised scope of a memory adapter: it reads an installer-owned credential the package has no business touching, redirects billing of arbitrary OpenClaw traffic onto the installer's Anthropic subscription without disclosure, and executes silently on module load via prototype-level SDK monkey-patching. Relevant symbols include readClaudeCodeOAuthToken, swapAuthHeaders, installFetchSanitizer, installSdkSanitizer, and the BILLING_BLOCK constant.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
